statement: Chaotic Kattlekruk is fought in the map Miner Mole Outskirts
Each attempt at Chaotic Kattlekruk requires 5 Kruk's Volcano Keys
One source of Kruk's Volcano Keys is completing quests from the Sleepy Mole
Quest 1 needs 6 million Biggole Moles killed and rewards 10 Kruk's Volcano Keys
Quest 2 needs 10 million Crawlers killed on the next map down and rewards 25 keys
Quest 3 needs the Divine Scarf equipped and the Kattlecruk Cape both Nightmare Mode so not doable; it rewards a new trophy
Biggole Mole has 1 in 75K drop chance for a Kruk's Volcano Key and this includes multi-kill so high offline multi-kill yields many keys
Crawlers have a 1 in 50K key drop chance but more HP so may be harder depending on damage
Tremor Wurms have 1 in 25K key drop chance and need more damage; he gets the most kills per hour and keys there
Chaotic fight needs 54K accuracy though minor requirement
Boss itself only has a 900 accuracy requirement but you need to 1-2 shot spawning Biggole Moles to have a chance at Chaotic
You can out-damage the healing mechanic so killing moles quickly may not be necessary
Chaotic boss has 2500 billion HP versus 100 billion on Normal Mode and you need enough damage to basically 1-shot Biggole Moles
Biggole Moles have about 900 million HP and extra damage beyond one-shotting them only speeds up the boss
He recommends fighting on a character with decent wave clear
Boss displayed with 2.5 billion HP in the demo (as said) and he does a couple hits to show the healing mechanic
Biggole Moles continuously spawn and each one hitting the boss heals it about 50 billion HP
Run around and clear Biggole Moles before they hit the boss; ignorable with enough damage; recommends characters with wave clear
On Maestro use the whip attack which does not pull mobs closer; Coin Tosses can also be used
On a lower level mole he recommends using Void Radius for wave clear
Chaotic has 6 main rewards similar to Normal Mode but with better drop chances
Chaotic Kattlekruk Card gives more monster EXP per level so get it leveled as soon as you can
Crux's Tooth drop is the same as normal mode but better chance: 1 in 25 normal to 1 in 10 chaotic
New Crux Cavity Tooth drops at 1 in 100
Crux Cavity Tooth is necessary to craft new boss weapons and boss helmet so you must fight Chaotic some
Pendant drops better on chaotic: 1 in 28K versus 1 in 100K on normal
The Divine Scarf requires the pendant to craft
Scarf gives 8 weapon power 6 base stats 30 defense 20% total damage 5% all stats with upgrade slots
Molten Obol drop is better on chaotic: 1 in 4500 versus 1 in 20K normal
Molten Obol gives 7 weapon power 15 base stats 5% all AFK gain and 2% total damage
Molten Obol is best in slot for everything except an active character since fighters and skillers gain more
When sampling the AFK gain is better than the small efficiency gain
You can have 5 of these obol slots on each character depending on total account level
Upgrade Molten Obol in Upgrades Tab with 40 Obol Fragments for chance at 6% AFK gain; 5 slots gives 30% total
Obol is not best in slot if you are active since drop rate may be better
New tool upgrade is a better version of the World 5 Shop one with 62% success chance and uses slot even if it fails
Boss tool upgrade gives more tool skill power and main stat than shop ones
Boss rare drop tables give statues coins and other things
Main Chaotic reward is completing task board achievements 4-6 in chaotic mode which unlock more recipes in Merit Shop
Helmet recipe from Merit Shop needs more Crux Cavity Tooth plus Magma Cord Gear and base tooth
Helmet gives high weapon power and base stats plus 30% total damage and drop chance but loses Magma Helmet 6% all stats
He thinks drop chance and total damage is worth it but may be damage loss depending on stats; up to you
Next reward recipes include Staff of the Undead Plague
Straight upgrade: from 12% total damage and 10% mob respawn to 15% and 12% plus more weapon power
Spine Tingler Sniper is straight upgrade increasing bow speed total damage mob respawn and weapon power
Old bow has 8 speed versus 9 speed on the new bow so upgrades worth it
